The Company has clarified that "The Company had over the last two years reduced its exposure in the construction equipment business given the difficult state of infrastructure sector in India. The Company systematically reduced its exposure from a peak of over Rs. 1,000 crore of receivables under financing down to Rs. 448 crore as of 31 March 2014. The decision to reduce exposure in this business has been communicated in the annual reports of the Company for FY13 and FY14. Given the continued poor performance and no visibility of improvement in this sector in the near term, the Company has decided to exit this business. The decision to exit this business has no material impact on the operations of the Company since this business contributes to less than 2% of its total receivables under finance".

The Company has clarified that "The company based on a recent whistleblower complaint, had identified fraudulent connivance between a few senior employees and some delinquent customers in its Mortgage business. This resulted in manipulation of a few customer EMI payments and consequent mis-reporting of delinquencies. The early detection and quick investigation carried by the company has resulted in the incidence having no material financial loss. The RBI NPA provisioning standards require NBFCs to provision at 180 DPD. Based on RBI norms, there is a Rs. 15 Lacs provision to be made on account of this event; however, the gross and net NPA remains unchanged. Since, the company maintains a more stringent provisioning policy over RBI norms, an additional provision of up to Rs. 5 Crores may be required in the current quarter. Post the investigation, the company has separated with concerned employees. For good order sake, the company has conducted a rapid portfolio review across all its other SME businesses and has not found anything adverse".

attchmntText: Bajaj Auto Finance Ltd has informed the Exchange that the Board of Directors at their meeting held on October 13, 2005 inter alia took the following decisions :- 1) The Board decided to increase the Authorised Share Capital of the Company to Rs. 50 crores from the existing Rs. 20 crores, subject to the approval of shareholders in General Meeting.  2) The matter regarding raising of funds for the Company through various means including further issue of shares shall be taken up in the next Board Meeting.

Bajaj Auto Finance Ltd has informed the Exchange that the Company has issued a press release dated October 13,2005 in respect of its unaudited financial results for the period ended September 30, 2005. The details of the press releases shall be available on the NSE website (http://www.nseindia.com) under: Corporates > Latest Announcements and on the Extranet Server (/Common/CorporateAnnouncements).

Bajaj Auto Finance Ltd has informed the Exchange that the Company has issued a press release after its AGM held on July 15, 2005. The details of the same shall be available on the NSE website (http://www.nseindia.com) under: Corporates > Latest Announcements and on the Extranet Server (/Common/CorporateAnnouncements).

Bajaj Auto Finance Ltd has submitted to the Exchange a copy of the Notice of AGM of the shareholders of the company to be held on July 15, 2005. The details of the AGM Notice shall be available on the NSE website (http://www.nseindia.com) under: Corporates > Latest Announcements and on the Extranet Server /Common/CorporateAnnouncements).

Bajaj Auto Finance Ltd has informed the Exchange that the Company has announced the Book Closure from July 01, 2005 to July 15, 2005 (both days inclusive) for the purpose of AGM to be held on July 15, 2005 and payment of dividend @ 75% (Rs.7.50 per share).

Bajaj Auto Finance Ltd has informed the Exchange that the Board of Directors in their Meeting held on May 10, 2005 have decided to re-appoint Shri Dipak Poddar as Managing Director of the Company, for a fresh term of five years, with effect from April 01, 2005. The said re-appointment and remuneration payable to him is subject to the approval of Members in General Meeting.

Bajaj Auto Finance Ltd has submitted to the Exchange a copy of the Press Release issued by the Company in respect of the approved accounts for the year ended March 31, 2005. The details of the press release shall be available on the NSE website (http://www.nseindia.com) under: Corporates > Latest Announcements and on the Extranet Server (/Common/CorporateAnnouncements).

Bajaj Auto Finance Ltd has informed the Exchange that the BOD's at its meeting held on May 10, 2005, have recommended a Dividend of Rs.7.50/- per Share (75%) for the year 2004-2005 (Previous Year : 60%).

Bajaj Auto Finance Ltd has informed the Exchange that the Board of Directors of the Company have decided to raise Rs.100 Crores through the issue of Secured Redeemable Non-Convertible Debentures on Private Placement basis, to part finance the working capital requirements and general corporate purposes.
desc: Issue of Debentures on Private Placement

attchmntText: Bajaj Auto Finance Ltd has informed the Exchange that the BOD's in their meeting held on January 18, 2005 have appointed Shri Sanjiv Bajaj as an Additional Director of the Company.
